description: I’m Nidhi, an IT Project Manager and solo participant from Thunder Bay, Ontario. After experiencing the effects of this year’s wildfire season, I’m building Fireline Replay, a dashboard that combines NASA satellite hotspot data and uses SI to analyze wildfire activity & generate interactive maps and charts. I bring experience in software delivery, product planning, and analytics. I’m open to connecting with others skilled in GIS, AI, or data visualisation.
